column1: In the Application Insights schema, incoming DAB HTTP request telemetry is stored in {{c1::requests}}.
column2:
Use this table to examine request names, durations, response codes, and success status.
Review source

column1: In the Application Insights schema, recorded DAB calls to SQL and other external services appear in {{c1::dependencies}}.
column2:
Dependency duration helps separate database-call time from overall API request time.
Review source

column1: In the Application Insights schema, captured DAB exceptions and their call stacks appear in {{c1::exceptions}}.
column2:
An error log message without a recorded exception belongs in traces instead.
Review source

column1: The W3C HTTP header that carries a request's trace identity and parent context is {{c1::traceparent}}.
column2:
Participating services propagate this context to connect related steps of a distributed request.
Review source

column1: In the Application Insights schema, correlated request and dependency records share an {{c1::operation_Id}} value.
column2:
This groups telemetry for the root operation. It differs from each individual record's own identifier.
Review source

column1: With Container Apps' direct Log Analytics integration, container stdout and stderr logs are stored in {{c1::ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL}}.
column2:
Filter to the DAB application or revision, then inspect Log_s for diagnostic messages.
Review source

column1: Limit an Application Insights query to the last hour with {{c1::where timestamp > ago(1h)}}.
column2:
Choose a time range that matches the incident or performance period.
Review source

column1: For recorded Application Insights requests, calculate 95th-percentile latency with {{c1::percentile(duration, 95)}}.
column2:
Use requests | summarize P95 = percentile(duration, 95). P95 estimates the duration at or below which 95% of observations fall.
Review source

column1: To group Application Insights requests by endpoint, complete requests | summarize AvgDuration = avg(duration) {{c1::by name}}.
column2:
Rank the resulting averages to identify slow request names.
Review source

column1: In Application Insights queries, group telemetry into hourly time buckets with {{c1::bin(timestamp, 1h)}}.
column2:
Use this expression in a summarize grouping clause to compare query duration across time periods.
Review source

column1: When SQL text is collected, it can appear in the Application Insights dependencies field {{c1::data}}.
column2:
Use recorded statements to identify the SQL operations behind slow requests.
Review source

column1: In Application Insights dependencies, filter records classified as SQL calls with {{c1::where type == "SQL"}}.
column2:
Then summarize duration and failures to investigate recorded database calls.
Review source
